messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "stop using and call doctor at once if coughing up blood"
set: ["stop using and call doctor at once if coughing up blood", "stop using and call doctor at once", "stop using and call doctor at once if blood in the urine", "stop using and call doctor at once if inflammation of blood vessels", "stop using and call doctor at once if painful urination", "stop using and call doctor at once if shortness of breath", "stop using and call doctor at once if any skin rash", "stop using and call doctor at once if signs of stomach bleeding", "stop using and call doctor at once if bloody or tarry stools", "stop using and call your doctor at once if serious side effects occur", "stop using and call doctor at once if swelling or rapid weight gain", "stop taking and call doctor at once if symptoms occur", "stop using and call doctor at once if vomit that looks like coffee grounds", "stop using and call doctor at once if first sign of any skin rash", "call doctor at once if high blood potassium", "stop using and tell doctor if pregnant"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
